model_annotation: The plot illustrates the number of building permits issued for new constructions from 2012 to 2022, categorized by type. The x-axis represents the years, with a linear scale ranging from 2012 to 2022, marked at every year. The y-axis represents the number of building permits issued, with a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 8169, although the exact lower limit is not labeled. Three lines are shown in the plot: a blue line representing "Административни" (Administrative), an orange line representing "Други" (Other), and a grey line representing "Жилищни" (Residential). The blue line starts at 170 in 2012 and ends at 70 in 2022, with values fluctuating between 156 and 187 from 2013 to 2015, then decreasing to 70 by 2022, with a notable low of 70 in 2022. The orange line begins at 4938 in 2012, decreases to 4323 in 2014, and then increases to 5980 in 2019 before decreasing to 4631 in 2022. The grey line starts at 4238 in 2012, decreases to 4120 in 2013, and then generally increases to 8169 in 2022, with a significant jump between 2020 and 2022.
